messages:
Nora: Quick FYI 1 Sam's birthday is next Monday (5/5). Thinking of a sunny potluck lunch at noon in the courtyard. Bring food, or we'll do a cake + picnic vibe. Thoughts? :sun_with_face: :tada:
people-ops-bot: Note: budget code `POPS-36`. React with :plate_with_cutlery: if you can bring food, :gift: if you're chipping in for a gift card, or :raised_hands: if you can help set up.
Jules: I'll bring a big Greek salad and plates/utensils. :salad:
Pri: I can do a vegan main (lentil shepherd's pie). Also happy to label dishes with allergens.
Sam: I'm here for whichever — low-key please. Also I have a strict nut allergy so please keep anything with nuts separate.
Marco: I'll pick up a small chocolate cake (GF option?) and napkins. Marco: PS can someone confirm GF cake size options?
Lina: There's a GF bakery on 7th that does small round cakes. I can order if folks want GF slices.
Hao: Remote but I'll send a video and chip in $20 for gift card. Will forward to Nora.
Nora: Thanks all. Can people drop dietary tags here by Fri EOD? Jen from kitchen asked about soy/egg preferences too.
people-ops-bot: Poll created  React with :cake: for cake + lawn blankets, :bento: for potluck only, or :picnic_table: for catered picnic box. Poll ends Fri 6pm.
Jules: :bento: (bringing salad + hummus)
Pri: :bento: (vegan main)
Marco: :cake: (bringing cake, will add a GF label if Lina orders GF)
Lina: I'll place GF cake order today. ETA delivery Mon 11:30am.
Hao: Sent video clip.
people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled Mon 11:40am "Set up picnic area and put out blankets".
Nora: Who can bring blankets and a bluetooth speaker? Also volunteer to take a group photo?
Jules: I'll bring two blankets and a speaker.
Marco: I'll take photos.
Nora: Perfect. For remote folks: we'll DM gift card and upload the group photo in #memes. Anyone want to contribute extra for a nicer gift card? Reply here.
Hao: I'll add $20 (done).
Pri: I'll add $10 via Venmo.
people-ops-bot: Donation tracker updated. Total extras: $50.
Nora: Great. Last ask  please drop food labels at the table (vegan/GF/contains-egg/contains-soy/contains-nuts). I'll make labels. See you Monday noon! :confetti_ball:
